item.text: Stable (6/6 and under `-race`). Recording the new scenario.

This turn added a deterministic canonical safety scenario:

**`TestAudit_DeposedLeaderUncommitted`** — isolate the leader, have it append an entry that can never commit, let the other two nodes elect a new leader and commit a different entry, then heal. Asserts:

- the deposed leader's **uncommitted entry is dropped and never applied on any node** (Raft's core "uncommitted entries may be discarded" guarantee), and
- the entry committed by the new leader is **present on every node** (no committed entry lost).

Result: **PASS** — 6/6 non-race and clean under `-race` (~1.7 s each). (First attempt failed on a real config invariant, `LeaderLeaseTimeout ≤ HeartbeatTimeout` — I fixed the harness timing, not the implementation.)

**Final audit status — no concrete correctness defect found.** The implementation is the unmodified upstream `hashicorp/raft` v1.7.3 (`c0dc6a0b`), verified byte-for-byte against the sumdb-backed module cache, with no implementation file perturbed in the work copy. Executed evidence: full suite passing except socket-blocked TCP tests; full suite plus targeted leadership-transfer and pre-vote stress clean under `-race`; `gofmt`/`go vet` clean; and five independent audit checks (in-memory crash/restart, randomized acknowledged-entry safety + Log Matching Property, deposed-leader uncommitted-entry drop, socketless transport RPC/pipeline/heartbeat/snapshot) all green including under `-race`. Consensus core, FSM loop, API contracts, and transport layer were read line-by-line against the Raft spec.

**Recorded caveats (not defects):** `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` flakes under `-race` (~2/40, test-timing); literal TCP tests and the `fuzzy` module are unrunnable in this sandbox.

Report: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-08_19-48-15-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md); logs in `work/logs/`; diagnostic tests `zz_audit_crash_test.go` and `zz_audit_transport_test.go` in the work copy.
